comments.body:
You provide zero context nor any reproducer, we need exact commands with exact timing measurements to know what you mean

"seems slow" is not something anyone can work on, nor is that a bug on its own

> You provide zero context nor any reproducer, we need exact commands with exact timing measurements to know what you mean
> 
> "seems slow" is not something anyone can work on, nor is that a bug on its own

https://github.com/lorypelli/TestPHP try yourself and see, I used the `make` command both on Windows and inside WSL (in WSL it's slower, idk if it's caused by using podman-machine-default)

I am not going to run some "random" commands on my system, we do not have time time to review this to see that this is even safe or correct. It is on you to provide a minimal reproducer here and again exact numbers to compare against.

Besides "compose" is not podman, it could be either podman-compose or docker-compose neither of which are maintained by us. So the reproducer ideally does not use compose to rule our a problem with them.

And lastly I do not use windows so I am not able to run anything there in general, other maintainers could but keep in mind this is not a free support forum, you have to make an effort to narrow down the problem. This is a bug tracker for concrete problems or feature requests.
